answer: The thread schedule is applied in onyx and gale publishes each instalment. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split which means 47% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1377 identities would post 4620 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
